newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $962 mln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $962 mln for Wednesday.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for Wednesday are expected to total $962 million in 25 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $443 million in 12 sales. The largest is a two-part $300 million Port Authority of New York and New Jersey deal at 1100 EST.
Negotiated sales total $519 million in 13 offerings. The largest is a $95 million Philadelphia Parking Authroity issue through Wheat First Butcher Singer.
An additional $287 million of deals are on the possible calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Wednesday depending on market conditions.
